assumptions.statement: Official polygons, regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, utilities, heritage, fire and engineering conditions are not available in the cleared package.
assumptions.impact: All spatial moves remain conceptual and require whole-package recalculation and professional review.

assumptions.statement: Conceptual building footprints and public workstations are not a survey of current buildings or ownership.
assumptions.impact: No parcel-level demolition, retention, construction or access commitment is made.

assumptions.statement: Crew roles, events, service-level targets and funding pathways are governance prototypes, not confirmed government or institutional commitments.
assumptions.impact: Each pilot requires a named operator, procurement route, public-interest review and stop condition.

assumptions.statement: No personal mobility trace, biometric, health, employment or private enterprise data is used in this package.
assumptions.impact: Future pilots must use minimum necessary data, consent where applicable, aggregation, human review and a non-AI service path.

assumptions.statement: International cases are used for transferable mechanisms rather than direct copying of spatial form, branding or policy.
assumptions.impact: All mechanisms must be re-tested against Haidian law, institutions, residents and site conditions.
